steps.precondition: fresh origin/main and local HEAD match approvedExecutionHead, execution worktree is clean, and a new Owner GO is required for any later mutation
steps.commandOrOperatorAction: Review backup, restore, monitoring, and data-copy evidence only
steps.verification: Compare authority, target ref, and evidence counters against canonical docs
steps.expectedResult: Read-only package evidence is consistent and mutation-free
steps.abortCondition: missing artifact, target mismatch, checksum mismatch, stale Owner GO, or hidden dependency

steps.expectedMutation: create notification foundation tables and RLS
steps.precondition: Owner GO present; preflight PASS; backup/recovery authority confirmed
steps.commandOrOperatorAction: Apply only the foundation SQL pack file
steps.verification: Re-run notification verification and catalog/RLS checks
steps.expectedResult: Foundation tables, indexes, policies, and service boundaries exist as tracked
steps.abortCondition: checksum mismatch, missing dependency, unexpected catalog drift, or failed verification
steps.rollbackDecisionPoint: after foundation verification and before RPC hardening

steps.expectedMutation: add notification RPCs and worker/runtime guards
steps.commandOrOperatorAction: Apply only the RPC hardening SQL pack file
steps.verification: Verify RPC signatures, grant model, and fail-closed runtime guards
steps.expectedResult: RPCs exist with tracked security-definer boundaries and no unwanted PUBLIC execution
steps.abortCondition: unexpected RPC exposure, checksum mismatch, or failed grant verification
steps.rollbackDecisionPoint: after RPC grant verification and before worker schema changes

steps.expectedMutation: expand delivery jobs and add worker run audit tables
steps.precondition: foundation and RPC hardening verified PASS
steps.commandOrOperatorAction: Apply only the delivery worker SQL pack file
steps.verification: Verify worker schema, runtime config defaults, and row-level security
steps.expectedResult: Worker schema remains fail-closed with production defaults
steps.abortCondition: unexpected worker enablement, checksum mismatch, or catalog drift
steps.rollbackDecisionPoint: after worker schema verification and before ops schema changes

steps.expectedMutation: add ops RPCs, environment columns, and queue controls
steps.commandOrOperatorAction: Apply only the ops SQL pack file
steps.verification: Verify ops RPCs, queue controls, and environment restrictions
steps.expectedResult: Ops helpers remain service-role-only and production-fail-closed
steps.abortCondition: unexpected public exposure, checksum mismatch, or failed queue control verification
steps.rollbackDecisionPoint: after ops verification and before runtime config re-assertion

steps.commandOrOperatorAction: Apply only the runtime config SQL pack file
steps.verification: Verify config keys remain production-fail-closed and project_ref-bound
steps.expectedResult: Runtime config is locked to production and worker disablement remains in place
steps.abortCondition: config mismatch, checksum mismatch, or unexpected enablement
steps.rollbackDecisionPoint: after config verification and before security hardening

steps.expectedMutation: tighten function grants and security-definer search_path
steps.commandOrOperatorAction: Apply only the security hardening SQL pack file
steps.verification: Verify grants, search_path, and service-role-only execute boundaries
steps.expectedResult: Public/client roles remain denied and worker/ops helpers remain constrained
steps.abortCondition: PUBLIC exposure, checksum mismatch, or failed grant verification
steps.rollbackDecisionPoint: after security verification and before deployment

steps.expectedMutation: build and deploy the tracked application commit
steps.precondition: database state verified PASS, flags still fail-closed, and deployment rollback target available
steps.verification: Verify deployed SHA and health of Vercel production deployment
steps.expectedResult: Latest production deployment matches the approved commit and remains healthy
steps.abortCondition: deployment health failure, checksum mismatch, or unexpected environment drift

steps.precondition: deployment health PASS and monitoring owners ready
steps.commandOrOperatorAction: Observe canary window with named operators and no expansion until thresholds pass
steps.verification: Check tenant isolation, auth, RPC, integrity, and advisor thresholds
steps.expectedResult: Canary passes without abort triggers before any traffic expansion
steps.abortCondition: cross-tenant exposure, auth failure, RPC critical failure, integrity mismatch, or Advisor ERROR
steps.rollbackDecisionPoint: during canary window before any traffic expansion
steps.rollbackArtifact: previous Vercel production deployment and approved rollback controls

steps.commandOrOperatorAction: Run the post-deploy verification checklist and record evidence
steps.verification: Compare deployed SHA, catalog, RLS/RBAC, anon/PUBLIC, auth, storage, logs, and monitoring window
steps.expectedResult: All post-deploy checks pass or are dispositioned exactly as documented
steps.abortCondition: unexpected drift, failing verification, or hidden dependency
steps.rollbackDecisionPoint: after the first failing verification item

steps.precondition: all prior steps PASS and evidence package remains unchanged
steps.commandOrOperatorAction: Owner reviews package manifest SHA256, execution window, and named operators before issuing any new GO
steps.verification: Confirm exact package version, manifest checksum, and merged package SHA
steps.expectedResult: Owner reissues GO only if exact package and exact target still match
steps.abortCondition: any package drift, stale authorization, or mismatch in target, SHA, or window
